title: bmonitor for SteamOS: iPhone camera monitor on the Legion Go S
description: bmonitor on a handheld: monitor and remote control for Blackmagic Camera on iPhone over Wi‑Fi, opened from the Steam library. In testing on the Lenovo Legion Go S.
s_hero_sub: bmonitor for SteamOS shows and controls Blackmagic Camera on your iPhone over Wi‑Fi. You open it from the Steam library like a game and adjust everything with the controller buttons.
s_cta_mac: Use it on a Mac today
s_hero_meta: Test build 0.1.1 · Tested on the Lenovo Legion Go S with SteamOS
s_deck_hint: Press X or Y on the drawn handheld, or tap ISO and shutter on the bar. B closes.
s_deck_note: Interface drawn to the app's real layout. The person is an AI-generated illustration.
s_fact_4: Gives the camera back on quit
s_map_sub: Each button opens one control directly. The bar under the video shows, next to each value, the button that opens it. Hold LT and the whole map appears over the video.
s_map_alt: Map of the handheld's buttons. Camera: RT records, X opens ISO, Y shutter, B white balance, A focus, left and right change the lens, LB and RB zoom. Monitor: up opens grid and safe area, down opens audio, View the script, Menu opens More, and holding LT shows this map.
s_m_b: WB and tint · closes the panel
s_m_menu: More: format, script from your phone, quit
s_m_touch: Focuses on the spot and picks values
s_points_title:
In front of the camera
and behind it.
s_points_sub: Propped next to the tripod, it's the monitor you read from across the room. In your hands, between takes, it's the remote.
s_p1_body: REC with a red border, timecode, minutes left, signal and battery sit on the edges. The middle of the frame stays clear, and problems show from a distance.
s_p2_body: Record, ISO, shutter and FPS, white balance and tint, tap to focus, zoom, lens, recording format, audio input and gain. The screen shows the value the camera confirmed.
s_p3_body: The Mac app's grids and the vertical safe areas: Instagram and Facebook, TikTok, Shorts, 3:4 grid and 1:1 square. L/R meter and the camera's sound, which starts muted so it doesn't feed back.
s_script_sub: Game mode has nowhere to paste text. The handheld shows an address and a QR code, you paste one script or several on your phone or Mac, and they show up next to the video.
s_script_caption: With the script open, the video moves to the left and nothing covers it. Drawn interface; illustrative image.
s_st1_title: Open More › Script from your phone
s_st1_body: The Menu button opens More. The handheld shows its address on your home network and a QR code.
s_st2_title: Point your phone at the QR code
s_st2_body: On your phone or Mac, on the same Wi‑Fi, the page opens in the browser.
s_st3_body: The script shows up on the handheld right away. View shows and hides it, holding View switches scripts, and each push on the left stick moves to the next paragraph.
s_lat_sub: In Dante's test on October 23, 2026, with the same iPhone, the handheld ran 8 ms behind the Mac app, less than the measurement's margin.
s_lat_caption: Glass to glass is the time between a clock in front of the camera and its image on the screen. On the handheld, median of 19 readings, from 235 to 360 ms. About 200 ms of it happens inside the iPhone, before the video leaves over Wi‑Fi.
s_a1: In desktop mode, download the .flatpak file from the release page on GitHub and install it with flatpak install --user. Then add bmonitor as a non-Steam game and open it from game mode. The test build doesn't update itself: new builds show up in the same list on GitHub.
s_q2: Does it work on the Steam Deck or another handheld?
s_a2: The only device tested is the Lenovo Legion Go S with SteamOS. Another SteamOS handheld might work, but nobody has tested one yet.
s_a3: A Legion Go S with SteamOS, an iPhone with Blackmagic Camera (free), and both on the same Wi‑Fi. The first time, the handheld looks for the iPhone on the network. If it can't find it, you type the IP, and it remembers the last one.
s_q4: What does it change on the iPhone?
s_a4: To send video to the handheld, the app switches Blackmagic Camera's live stream platform. When you quit, it puts the original back, including when you close it from the Steam menu.
s_a5: Following your speech in the script, the Mac's webcam, several cameras at once, and recording on the handheld. Recording stays on the iPhone, as on the Mac.
s_close_title:
On a Mac, you can
use it today.
s_deck_hint_touch: Tap ISO or shutter on the bar to open its ruler.
